THE BANNERHOLD · SOLFORIZ
The terraced holding — site and outer territory (400 × 360 m modelled terrain)
First-pass layout for the shared pipeline
Right-handed, Y-up, metres · +X east · +Z south · origin = settlement datum · drawn from the blueprint data · names are working placeholders
TERRAIN LOGIC
An escarpment falls from a plateau (+34 m) in the north-west to a mineral basin (−13 m) in the south-east. The holding
is an engineered cascade of four level terraces — the manor at +14 m, houses and the parade court at +8 m, the market
and works at +2 m, the gate court at −3 m — held by thick retaining walls and joined by stairs on one axial spine. A dry
wadi runs past the south-west wall; a stone rill carries the manor's cistern water down the spine to a reservoir and the
oasis gardens.

ATMOSPHERE
Late afternoon: a low, heavy sun in a sulfur-yellow haze, the basin glowing below the terraces. Key light from 232° at
19° (veiled-sun); fog 260–3200 m; wind toward 60° at 6 m/s.
